d: Namaste, Chinese auto giant BYD just launched their luxury wing, Denza, in India. Along with the brand, they launched two cars: the Denza D9 MPV and the Denza Z9 GT. While the Denza D9 is priced at Rs 90 lakh ex-showroom, the sportier GT car, the Denza Z9 GT, will cost Rs 1.56 crore Ex-Showroom. Bookings are live, and delivery timelines are on a case-by-case basis, as both cars will be CBUs.
